user.title: Dynamic HVAC Control Setup
user.description:
Connect your physical thermostat, optional blower fan, remote temperature helper, and presence tracker.

💡 Pro Tip: If using a Home Assistant Average (Min/Max) Helper, include your wall thermostat's built-in temperature sensor in that helper. Because the wall unit is hardwired to 24V power, your average helper will remain online even if battery-powered room sensors drop offline.

data_description.name: Name shown for this thermostat in Home Assistant.
data_description.target_climate: Your real wall thermostat that this integration controls.
data_description.temperature_sensor: The room or whole-house average sensor the system regulates to.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional indoor humidity reading shown on the card. It doesn't affect control.
data_description.fan_entity: The thermostat's fan control, used for Fan On/Auto.
data_description.presence_sensor: Person or tracker used for Away and errand logic.
data_description.return_temp_sensor: Optional return-air temperature probe shown on the card. It doesn't affect control.
data_description.return_humidity_sensor: Optional return-air humidity probe shown on the card. It doesn't affect control.
data_description.supply_temp_sensor: Optional supply-air temperature probe shown on the card. It doesn't affect control.
data_description.supply_humidity_sensor: Optional supply-air humidity probe shown on the card. It doesn't affect control.

presets.title: Setpoints, Swings & Offsets
presets.description: Configure your default temperatures, swings, offsets, and vacation hold targets.

data.heating_offset: Heating Dynamic Offset (°F - default: 1.0 for Heat Pump Aux protection)

data_description.cooling_swing: How far above the target the house can warm before cooling starts.
data_description.heating_swing: How far below the target the house can cool before heating starts.
data_description.cooling_offset: How much lower than your target the wall thermostat is set while cooling, so it doesn't stop early.
data_description.heating_offset: How much higher than your target the wall thermostat is set while heating. Keep it small to avoid heat-pump aux heat.
data_description.min_cycle_duration: Shortest time the compressor must run, and must rest between runs, to prevent short-cycling.
data_description.errand_delay: How long everyone must be gone before switching to Away, so quick trips don't change anything.
data_description.immunity_duration: After a Comfort slot starts, how long presence is ignored so the house can cool before you arrive.
data_description.comfort_cool: Target temperature used when Comfort is active while cooling.
data_description.comfort_heat: Target temperature used when Comfort is active while heating.
data_description.eco_cool: Target temperature used when Eco is active while cooling.
data_description.eco_heat: Target temperature used when Eco is active while heating.
data_description.away_cool: Target temperature used when Away is active while cooling.
data_description.away_heat: Target temperature used when Away is active while heating.
data_description.sleep_cool: Target temperature used when Sleep is active while cooling.
data_description.sleep_heat: Target temperature used when Sleep is active while heating.
data_description.boost_cool: Target temperature used when Boost is active while cooling.
data_description.boost_heat: Target temperature used when Boost is active while heating.
data_description.vacation_cool: Target temperature used when Vacation is active while cooling.
data_description.vacation_heat: Target temperature used when Vacation is active while heating.
